runtime: Bun 1.4.2 (repository packageManager pin), downloaded to a disposable directory; system Bun unchanged

findings.problem: An in-flight question or automatic status could publish after cancellation while it waited for the draft lock.
findings.fix: Recheck the run after taking the draft lock and hold a shared row lock through publication. An ended outcome turn gets a non-retryable, not-delivered receipt. A publication that wins commits before cancellation can return.
findings.regression: Both default control and treatment; text and widget cancellation while blocked, plus the opposite commit order.

findings.problem: Queued cancellation and worker claim could deadlock by locking run and inbox in opposite orders. Reproduced in the real worker integration and confirmed in PostgreSQL deadlock logs.
findings.fix: Queued cancellation now takes the existing per-bot claim advisory lock before either row. If claim wins, cancellation takes the existing running-turn path.
findings.regression: Controlled real PostgreSQL claim/cancel overlap, the existing queued-to-running unit regression, and the real worker automation integration.

validation.method: Fresh Bun process per test file. Server, worker and messaging use separate disposable PostgreSQL databases; each schema is reset between files. The computer suite leaves platform/live-browser opt-in checks disabled.
reruns: The complete server and worker matrices were rerun after the final queued-cancellation fix.
The computer schema-parity test was rerun after correcting its stale expectation for the existing presentation type. Other computer production code is unchanged in this pass.
validation.architecture: All four workspace/contract/iOS/duplication boundary checks passed.

nativeComputerUse.method: Native Chrome through cua_repl; actual ExternalDraftCard component rendered by Vite, backed by isolated real draft/messaging/worker services. State polled by fixture; not the deployed app stream. Fixture refuses send actions.
